subject: Decision Making
title: Symptoms of Groupthink
description: A short lesson to help you apply Symptoms of Groupthink.

hook.text: Groupthink has eight warning signs. If you spot three or more, the group is probably making a bad decision.

buildup.text: Illusion of invulnerability: the group feels unstoppable. Collective rationalization: they explain away warning signals.

discovery.text: Self-censorship: members stay quiet. Illusion of unanimity: silence is read as agreement. Mindguards filter out dissent.

twist.text: Pressure on dissenters is the clearest sign. When someone voices doubt and the group pushes back, groupthink is active.

climax.text: These symptoms are invisible to the group itself. Groupthink feels like unity, confidence, and strength from the inside.

punchline.text: Feels like unity, acts like blindness. Groupthink hides inside confidence.

quiz.question: Why is groupthink hard to detect from within the group?
options: It feels like unity and confidence rather than a flaw in the process
